title: Hanjuku Hero - Ah, Sekai yo Hanjuku Nare...!!
aliases: Hanjuku Hero: Ah, Sekai yo Hanjuku Nare...!!
description: Hanjuku Eiyuu/Hero is a Japan-exclusive series of real-time strategy video games and Aa Sekai Yo Hanjuku Nare is its first entry for the Super Famicom. It was directed by Takashi Tokita and published by Squaresoft (now Square-Enix).
